competition.title: Amazon ML Challenge 2026
competition.details:
Amazon ML Challenge is a two-stage competition where students from all engineering campuses across India will get a unique opportunity to work on Amazon’s dataset to bring in fresh ideas and build innovative solutions for a real-world problem statement. The top three winning teams will receive cash prizes and certificates.

Eligibility and Team Rules:

  • This competition is open to all students pursuing PhD/ M.E./M.Tech./ M.S./MS by Research/B.E./B.Tech. full-time degree across all engineering campuses in India. 
  • Graduation Year: 2027 or 2028
  • Each team must consist of a minimum of 2 and a maximum of 4 members.
  • Each team must have a team leader.
  • Cross-college teams are allowed.
  • One student cannot be a member of more than one team.

Competition Structure:

Stage 0: Join the AWS Builder Center 

Before registering for the ML Challenge 2026, participants are required to create their AWS Builder Center Profile ID. Please refer to the setup guide for step-by-step instructions on creating your AWS Builder Center Profile ID and completing the required setup before registration - Click Here

Stage 1 – Registration (7th - 20th September)

  • Participants are required to register for the challenge.
  • Participants must provide a valid AWS Builder Center Profile ID alias during registration.
  • Participants with an invalid alias will have an incomplete registration.
  • Participants must form a team of 2–4 members to participate in the challenge.

Stage 2 – ML Challenge | 72-Hour Hackathon (25th – 27th September)

  • All teams will get access to the problem statement with the dataset on day 1 and will have time to build and submit solutions till day 3.
  • Teams can track their performance through the leaderboard, which will reflect team rankings live over the course of this challenge.
  • Each team should upload a document between 1 and 2 pages detailing their approach to the solution, along with a zipped file containing the code, script, or notebook.

Stage 3 - Grand Finale (7th October):

Based on the leaderboard results and the solution presented in the document at the end of Round 1, the top 10 teams will be invited to the Grand Finale to present their solutions to Amazon's Scientists. The finale will be hosted live virtually on 7th October 2026.

Credits and Rewards:

  • The winners will be rewarded with a cash prize of INR 1,00,000/-, certificates and goodies.
  • The first runners-up will be rewarded with a cash prize of INR 75,000/-, certificates and goodies.
  • The second runners-up will be rewarded with a cash prize of INR 50,000/-, certificates and goodies.
  • Build More with $200 in Credits: All registered participants will receive $200 worth of credits to explore, experiment, and build using the available resources as part of the challenge.
  • Top 500 Get Additional $100 in Credits: At the 48-hour mark of the challenge, the Top 500 teams will receive $100 worth of credits, giving them additional resources to take their ideas further and continue building.
  • Certificates and exclusive Amazon SWAGs for the top 10 teams and top 10 women-only teams.
  • The top 50 teams in the Amazon ML Challenge will be rewarded with Pre-Placement Interviews (PPIs) for the role of Applied Scientist Intern at Amazon.

organisation.name: Amazon
organisation.description:
Amazon is a multinational technology giant that focuses on various services like e-commerce, cloud computing, digital streaming and artificial intelligence. It is one of the Big Five companies in the US IT industry, along with Google, Microsoft, Facebook and Apple

Jeff Bezos set up Amazon in 1994 as an online marketplace for books and then further expanded to sell electronics, games, apparel, furniture etc. In 2015, Amazon surpassed Walmart to become the most valuable retailer in US

Amazon Web Services was launched in 2002, which just provided internet traffic pattern and today more than 2 million people and businesses use Amazon’s services, worldwide

Amazon is committed to building a sustainable business for our customers and the planet. In 2019, Amazon co-founded The Climate Pledge—a commitment to be net-zero carbon across our business by 2040, 10 years ahead of the Paris Agreement. As part of this pledge, Amazon has made ambitious commitments toward reaching this goal

Product/Business Portfolio

1. Amazon Fresh

Amazon Fresh is the grocery delivery service which is available in major cities of US and then expanded around the globe to Berlin, Hamburg, London, Milan, Munich, Rome, Tokyo, Singapore and India. Amazon Fresh also opened six physical stores in US

2. Amazon Prime

Amazon Prime is a paid subscription service available in various countries, and gives users access to services like free delivery, one-day delivery and streaming services for music, video and e-books

3. Amazon Web Services

One of the largest subsidiaries of Amazon that provides on-demand cloud computing platforms and APIs to various entities on a metered-as-you-go basis

4. Alexa

Alexa is the virtual assistant AI technology developed by Amazon used in smart speakers like Amazon Echo and Smart Home technologies

5. Appstore

Appstore is the package app store for Amazon’s Fire OS operating system

6. Amazon Drive

Earlier known as Amazon Cloud Drive, Amazon Drive is a cloud storing application for cloud storage, file sharing, file backup etc

7. Echo

Amazon Echo is the brand of smart speakers that connects to the voice controlled personal assistant, Alexa

8. Kindle

Kindle is the series of e-readers that enables user to browse, buy, download and read e-books, newspapers, magazines etc

9. Fire Tablet

A series of tablet computers developed by Amazon

10. Fire TV

Fire TV is a line of Digital media players and microconsoles that deliver digital audio and video streamed through the internet

11. Amazon Digital Game Store

Digital video game distribution service managed by the international e-commerce arm of Amazon

12. Amazon Studios

Amazon studios is an American television and film producer and a distributor

13. A9.com

A company focussed on researching and building innovative technology

14. Amazon Maritime

Amazon Maritime holds a federal license to operate as a non-vessel owning common carrier to manage its shipments across the world

15. Audible

Audible is a seller and producer of spoken audio entertainment, information and educational programming on the internet

16. Goodreads

Gooodreads is a social cataloging website that allows users to freely search user populated database of books, annotations and reviews

17. Twitch

Twitch is a live streaming platform for video games

18. Amazon Operations - Customer fulfillment and Delivery network

It is a service that allows businesses to outsource order fulfillment and delivery to Amazon

Top 5 Competitors

  • Google
  • Walmart
  • Alibaba
  • Otto
  • Netflix

Recent News and Developments

  • Amazon launches Amazon Hub Delivery to empower local businesses across the U.S.
  • 1.25 lakh+ exporters on Amazon Global Selling to surpass $8 billion in cumulative exports from India in 2023
  • Amazon Future Engineer Launches Early Internship Program to Empower Women from Underprivileged Communities in India with Tech Experience in Various Roles at Amazon
  • Amazon joins hands with ‘Womennovator’ to enable 200 Indian Women Entrepreneurs ‘Go Global’
  • Amazon Sets a New Record for Most Renewable Energy Purchased by a Single Company
  • Amazon’s U.S. Small Business Empowerment Report Shows Continued Sales Growth for Independent Sellers

Opportunities at Amazon

Amazon carries out extensive hiring activities in B-Schools across the country. The roles that are typically offered by Amazon to BSchool graduates include Marketing Manager, Product Manager, InStock Manager, Sales Specialist, Merchandising Manager, Business Intelligence, Business Operations, Brand Development, Analytics and Insights, Partner Management, Business Development, Finance, Category management, Program Management, Brand Management etc to name a few

submission_types.title: information area
submission_types.accepted_values:
Every team must submit a single ZIP archive containing your code and outputs for the best submission. We use it to reproduce your results, audit your blocking approach, and verify compliance with the fair-play and model-license rules. The top teams' packages will be reviewed in detail before the final rankings are confirmed.

Submission Structure

<team_name>_submission.zip
├── output/
│   ├── matching_results.tsv        # Final matches (same file uploaded to the leaderboard)
│   └── candidate_pairs.tsv        # Your blocking candidate set
├── code/
│   └── business_entity_resolution/
│       ├── src/                    # All source code
│       ├── README.md               # End-to-end reproduction instructions
│       └── requirements.txt        # Pinned dependencies / environment
└── Documentation_template.md       # Your completed methodology write-up

File & Folder Requirements

  • output/ — Must contain the two TSV files described above:
    • matching_results.tsv — the final matching results, identical to the file uploaded to the leaderboard.
    • candidate_pairs.tsv — the candidate pairs generated during the blocking stage.
  • code/business_entity_resolution/ — Must contain a self-contained, runnable copy of your pipeline.
    • Place all source code under src/.
    • Include a README.md with exact instructions for reproducing the pipeline end-to-end.
    • Include a requirements.txt (or equivalent environment file) with pinned dependency versions.
    • The pipeline should be capable of regenerating both output files from the provided training/test data using only the contents of this folder.
  • Documentation_template.md — Complete the provided methodology template and include the filled-in file directly in the ZIP archive. The Markdown (.md) file is sufficient; a PDF export is also acceptable. There is no need to rename the file.
